🎥🎬: Abbott Elementary (2021–Present)

At an underfunded public school in Philadelphia, a group of dedicated teachers does everything they can to give their students a good education despite limited resources, challenging circumstances, and an often chaotic administration.

Optimistic second-grade teacher Janine Teagues refuses to give up on her students, while her quirky coworkers bring their own personalities, struggles, and teaching styles to the school. Together, they navigate workplace drama, friendships, and the everyday challenges of teaching.

source_details.synopsis: Abbott Elementary is an American mockumentary sitcom television series created by Quinta Brunson for ABC. It stars Brunson as Janine Teagues, a perpetually optimistic second-grade teacher at the underfunded Abbott Elementary, a fictional predominantly black public school in West Philadelphia. The ensemble cast includes Tyler James Williams, Janelle James, Lisa Ann Walter, Chris Perfetti, William Stanford Davis, and Sheryl Lee Ralph. The series premiered on December 7, 2021, and was met with critical acclaim and strong viewership numbers on Hulu and other delayed viewing methods.
